messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High continuous-batching latency spike detected in us-west-2. Error rate up 4.2% — routing to #eng-oncall. Metric snapshot: cb_queue_len=4200, cb_microbatch_avg=1.9ms, kv_evictions/sec=12k.

alex: on it. seeing a jump in 95th p99 token time from 220ms -> 1.8s. rolling incidents list. Is this only hosted?

mira: looks like both hosted and dedicated clusters in us-west-2, same service shard. KV cache miss rate shot from 4% -> 48%. eviction pressure is insane.

samir: tagging as P1. paging pager duty. any recent deploys to continuous-batching config?

jess: no app deploys in last 30m, but we pushed a controller feature flag for batch packing 45m ago. Might be related.

mike: customers reporting timeouts, Support ticket #8279 from Acme: several batch requests failed with 504. estimated customer impact: ~0.6% of calls in that region.

alex: copying logs from proxy: ```WARN streaming: queueing latency exceeded threshold (queue_len=3800)
ERROR runtime: microbatch assembly timeout after 2.5s
WARN kvcache: eviction loop active count=1.2k```

mira: digging into runtime metrics — at high concurrency (2000 concurrent graphs) microbatch size collapses to 1-2 tokens often which causes more KV loads per request. repeated cache misses + small microbatches => thrash.

samir: hypothesis: the new batch packing changes interact badly with prefix cache size heuristics under sustained concurrency, causing excessive KV eviction churn and causing requests to queue, making microbatches stay small — positive feedback loop.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) temp rollback packer flag -> previous packer, 2) increase microbatch_window_ms to allow larger microbatches, 3) reduce max_inflight_per_shard to shed load gracefully. Which is fastest?

mira: fastest is flipping the feature flag (runtime config) and bumping microbatch_window. We can patch via runtime-controller. I'll prepare the patch.

ops-bot: Deploy request queued: PATCH /runtime/config/shard/us-west-2 body {"batch_packer":"legacy","microbatch_window_ms":6} — requires two approvers.

jess: approving. :thumbsup:

samir: approving. :thumbsup:

mira: patch applied. Command used: ```curl -X PATCH https://ctrl.api/runtime/config/us-west-2 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"batch_packer":"legacy","microbatch_window_ms":6,"max_inflight_per_shard":1200}'``` Service responded 200. Rolling out config to all nodes.

alex: seeing immediate drop in queue_len: 4200 -> 900 in ~30s. p95 token time down to 430ms. kv_evictions/sec -> 1.1k.

mike: support: Acme reports some recovery, but a few calls still erroring, ETA for full recovery?

mira: continuing rollout across all hosts. There may be residual KV hot-keys causing localized eviction — doing targeted warm-up for top prefixes.

samir: set temporary throttles for non-critical traffic to reduce sustained concurrency — adding a 503-on-overload policy for bulk embedding jobs for 15m.

alex: applied throttle rule: ```redwoodctl policy create --name cb-overload-shed --route /embed/bulk --action 503 --threshold 800```

jess: monitoring customer impact. we're sending status update to affected customers.

incident-bot: Incident P1 created: cb-high-concurrency-thrash-2425001234. Paging schedule: alex -> mira -> samir.

mike: filed post to customers: "We experienced elevated latency and timeouts in us-west-2 due to KV cache eviction and batching interaction. We have rolled a config rollback and applied throttles. We are monitoring."

mira: post-mitigation notes: kv_eviction_rate stabilized ~1k/s, cache hit-rate back to 89% from 52%, queue_len trending down to baseline. Microbatch avg increased to 6.8ms (good), and average microbatch size up 3x.

alex: follow-ups: - validate packer change doesn't regress other workloads (run perf suite) - add circuit-breaker to detect packer-induced thrash early - add automated warmup for top prefixes after config changes - create a canary traffic policy for batch packer feature.

samir: also recommend adding a sliding-window limit on eviction rate per-shard and a soft-fail to fall back to synchronous exec if eviction_rate>5k/s.

jess: will coordinate customer comms and SLA credit assessment with finance. Current estimated p99 downtime window: ~14m peak, partial impact for ~40m.

alex: handing off to mira for postmortem + follow-ups. Mira, if you want to take lead, I'll mark oncall resolved once handoff confirmed.

mira: taking lead. adding initial notes to the incident board. Thanks team. :pray:

ops-bot: Reminder: add timeline events and add "configs/packers" and "kvcache" tags to incident.

mike: final check: any lingering alerts? I see a couple low-rate 5xxs but trending down.

alex: closing pager. last_message: 2425001320
